idea: Themed weeks, Economy day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In the 2022-23 accounts, Delhi's own tax revenue equalled 98.2% of its day-to-day (revenue) spending, the highest of 31 states and Union territories. Telangana (69.7%) and Gujarat (69.5%) came next; Tamil Nadu's figure was 53.7%.

Delhi was the highest in each of the 19 years of accounts from 2004-05. Own taxes are those a state raises itself. Delhi is a Union territory with a legislature. A funding mix, not a grade: the table shows how much, not why.
source: Reserve Bank of India, State Finances: A Study of Budgets, as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25: Table 168, own tax revenue (taxes the state raises itself), over Table 166, revenue expenditure (spending that does not create assets), rupees crore. 2022-23 is the latest year of actual accounts (A) in the Handbook; its 2023-24 and 2024-25 estimates are not used. 31 states and UTs have a figure: the 28 states, Delhi, Jammu and Kashmir, Puducherry. A funding mix, not a grade.
